question: Each homeopathic C step dilutes 1 part in 100. After how many steps would a whole mole leave under one molecule?
move: Repeated small divisions empty anything faster than intuition allows.
ask: Which good habit am I watering down a little at a time, until almost nothing of it is left?
trap: Guessing hundreds of steps, since 1 in 100 sounds mild.
hint: A mole is about 6 × 10^23 molecules; each step removes two powers of ten.
reference: Tiesinga et al., CODATA recommended values of the fundamental physical constants: 2018, Reviews of Modern Physics, 2021
